claims.content: To open a reversible-lane entrance.

scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The Operator opens a reversible-lane entrance in the selected direction, and the entrance reaches the corresponding Open South Bound or Open North Bound state.

Achieve the Open North Bound state

claims.content: Operator
The Operator is logged on to the system.
No opposite-direction entrance closure device has status 'unknown' or 'open'.
For Sequence #1 (Open South Bound), the roadway is in the Closed (PM) state and Gate 5 at Loc. 5 is OPEN; for Sequence #3 (Open North Bound), the roadway is in the Closed (AM) state.

The Operator initiates opening a reversible-lane entrance in the selected direction—by executing the applicable opening sequence (Sequence #1 for Open South Bound at 5:20 AM or Sequence #3 for Open North Bound at 11:15 AM), by initiating the 'Open Entrances' sequence, or by selecting 'Open a Reversible-Lane Entrance' from the main menu.

claims.content: The Operator initiates opening of a reversible-lane entrance in the selected direction by executing the applicable opening sequence (Sequence #1 for Open South Bound or Sequence #3 for Open North Bound), by initiating the 'Open Entrances' sequence, or by selecting 'Open a Reversible-Lane Entrance' from the main menu. The RLCS presents scheduled command operations to the operator at the GUI for confirmation prior to executing the command.
The system presents the command operations for the selected opening sequence to the Operator at the GUI for confirmation prior to executing the command.
The system executes the stored operational control command sequence for the selected direction based on the current system mode of operation and the schedule for the sequence.
The system opens the barrier gate.
The system opens the wrong-way transverse pop-ups.
The system opens the wrong-way longitudinal pop-ups beginning at the entrance ramp nose at the reversible lanes and proceeding toward the edge of shoulder.
The system opens the entrance transverse pop-ups in the direction from the reversible lanes toward the freeway.
The system opens the entrance longitudinal pop-ups downstream (entrance ramp nose at the freeway) to upstream (edge of shoulder).

The system opens the CMS by changing CMS messages from 'Closed' to 'Open', beginning with the furthest downstream sign (closest to the reversible lane) and proceeding upstream as message change confirmations are received from each sign.
The reversible-lane entrance reaches the selected Open South Bound or Open North Bound state.

Diverges from main flow Step 1 for the Open South Bound variant: the Operator initiates opening by executing Sequence #1 (Open South Bound), which opens the reversible-lane entrance in the South Bound direction.

Diverges from main flow Step 1 for the Open North Bound variant: the Operator initiates opening by executing Sequence #3 (Open North Bound), which opens the reversible-lane entrance in the North Bound direction.

claims.content: At main flow Step 3, during the opening sequence, if a device fails to report completion of the current sequence step within the response time window allotted for that step, the sequence shall be halted. If the offending device status can be corrected within the configurable time period defined in the database and in non-volatile memory, the Operator shall be able to issue a command to resume the opening sequence.

At main flow Step 3, during the opening sequence, if the status of a closure device previously opened at the current entrance changes to 'unknown' or 'closed' without an operator-initiated command, the sequence shall be halted. If the offending device status can be corrected within the configurable time period, the Operator shall be able to issue a command to resume the opening sequence.
At main flow Step 3, during the opening sequence, if the status of a closure device previously closed changes to 'unknown' or 'open' without an operator command, the sequence shall be halted.
At main flow Step 3, during the opening sequence, if the status of a closure device for the opposite direction of travel changes to 'unknown' or 'open', the sequence shall be halted.
At main flow Step 3, during the opening sequence, if unknown or improper closure device status occurs anywhere in the system, the system immediately terminates a 'device opening' command.

At main flow Step 3, during the opening sequence, if an intermediate step results in a device control failure, an Operator with proper security can use Device Override to continue the operating sequence through to the end by inputting a device status that overrides the status coming from the field.

At main flow Step 3, during the opening sequence, if the TMC workstations or network server fails and field status at the TMC is lost, alternate control shall be at FCU South or FCU North. The Operator shall be able to dial in from a backup computer to either FCU North or FCU South and open and close the reversible lanes.

At main flow Step 3, during the opening sequence, if FCU North or South fails (FCU controller failure or FCU-TSU communications failure), the changeable message signs and DCUs associated with the failed FCU are lost, and alternate control is at the non-failed FCU.

At main flow Step 3, during the opening sequence, if both FCUs North and South fail, alternate control units are direct control at DCUs 1-5 and CMS 1-12 control from CMS cabinets. The Operator shall be able to connect a laptop computer at the DCUs and operate the devices or perform manual operation from the MCU, and to connect a laptop on the CMS cabinet and control the signs or perform manual operation of the signs from the cabinet.
At main flow Step 3, during the opening sequence, if any DCU 1-5 fails, the field devices related to the failed DCU are lost, and alternate control is the MCU and manual control at the field devices.

At main flow Step 3, during the opening sequence, if the system allows or causes an entrance to be opened in one direction when an entrance in the opposite direction is already open (in the absence of full system overrides), the system has failed.

(still no supporting evidence after retrieval)

[exceptionflow_exit_coverage] Exception branch at main_flow step 3 halts the opening sequence when a previously opened closure device changes status without operator command and only defines resumption if the status is corrected within the configurable period; it does not specify the outcome if correction is not made in time. (still no supporting evidence after retrieval)

[exceptionflow_exit_coverage] Exception flow claim 0 halts the opening sequence on a device response timeout and only defines resumption if the device status is corrected within the configurable period. It does not specify the outcome when the status is not corrected, so that uncorrected branch lacks a clear terminal, handoff, or explicit failure state. (still no supporting evidence after retrieval)

It omits the outcome when the status is not corrected, leaving that branch without a clear exit state. (still no supporting evidence after retrieval)

It does not specify the outcome when the status is not corrected, so that uncorrected branch lacks a clear terminal, handoff, or explicit failure state.

inconsistency_hints: The Trigger allows initiation by executing Sequence #1/#3, by initiating the 'Open Entrances' sequence, or by selecting 'Open a Reversible-Lane Entrance' from the main menu. Main Flow step 1 only restates initiation by executing Sequence #1/#3, so for the menu or 'Open Entrances' trigger paths the flow does not continue from the actual initiating action and instead restarts at a different initiation.
